name: Air4U
hero_sub_en: air4u.co · Bogotá · Colombia · Circular Economy · Stage: Seed · CT-IN-001
hero_sub_es: air4u.co · Bogotá · Colombia · Economía Circular · Etapa: Seed · CT-IN-001
pitch_en: Manufactures ozone-based air purifiers eliminating microbiological load in homes, offices, and food plants without filters or chemicals.
pitch_es: Fabrica purificadores de aire basados en ozono que eliminan la carga microbiológica en hogares, oficinas y plantas de alimentos, sin filtros ni químicos.
cta_pitch_en: Colombian-made ozone air purifiers for homes, businesses, and industrial hygiene — legacy brand Airlife Ozono renewed as Air4U.
cta_pitch_es: Purificadores de ozono hechos en Colombia para hogares, empresas e higiene industrial — legado Airlife Ozono renovado como Air4U.

portfolio.problem_head_en: Indoor air in homes, workplaces, and food facilities carries microbes, odors, and contaminants.
portfolio.problem_head_es: El aire interior en hogares, lugares de trabajo y plantas de alimentos arrastra microbios, olores y contaminantes.
portfolio.problem_body_en: Traditional filtration and chemicals are not always enough for deep disinfection in sensitive environments such as food production and healthcare-related spaces.
portfolio.problem_body_es: La filtración tradicional y los químicos no siempre bastan para desinfección profunda en entornos sensibles como producción de alimentos.

solution_steps.text_en: Manufacture and install Colombian ozone generators that purify, deodorize, and disinfect indoor air for homes, commerce, and industry.
solution_steps.text_es: Fabricar e instalar generadores de ozono colombianos que purifican, desodorizan y desinfectan el aire interior para hogares, comercio e industria.

solution_steps.text_en: Air4U — CLAC21 · ClimateLaunchpad Colombia (CleantechHUB portfolio card AIR 4U).
Based in Bogotá, Colombia. Public site: air4u.co.
